changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md`

- names `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Both marketplace chunks were held by CHUNK CO-TENANCY, not by any import of the page: rolldown had parked `components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` (statically imported by the eager `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) in the first, and `console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` (bare-imported by the package barrel for its SDUI registration) in the second. An `app-shell-eager-leaves` group in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` isolates those co-tenants so the three declared-lazy pages chunk by their own dynamic-only reachability. The console eager closure moves 3180.2 KB → 3171.5 KB gzipped (−8,888 bytes, 48 → 45 eager chunks) with the three per-chunk ceilings unmoved.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `81778b955` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1796 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2403 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36698487791)

| Metric | Value | Budget |
|--------|-------|--------|
| **Eager closure** (gzip, 330 chunks) | **3570.6 KB** | 3607.4 KB |
| Main entry chunk (gzip) | 149.6 KB | 350 KB |
| Entry file | `index-VW6ADGre.js` | — |
| Status | **PASS** | — |

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d26b5a97b1fe129d848aab6d1537838fbef8e1ab`
Local-runs: none

PR objectui#11194 for card objectui#11181, head `d26b5a97b1fe`, the closure card of the label-map family. Inputs: the card's body and its five comments (triage `5906458280`, the triage pointer `5907732627`, claim `5907850818`, the seat's sequencing note `5908498158`, the dev report `5908734707`), the PR body, its 5-file list, the net diff against `main` (merge-base `37d166280`), the head's check-runs read with `filter=latest`, and the head's own sources read through the contents API for context (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `ObjectActionsPanel.tsx`, `metadata-admin/previews/navItemLabel.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `package.json`, and the 26 non-test sources of `views/studio-design/` for the sweep).

**Check-runs on the head.** When this review began, the eight Test shards, Type Check, Lint and Spec Main Shape Gate were still in progress; I waited in the foreground until every run completed. Final: 43 latest runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (Test (coverage), its matrix shard and dependabot, which are gated off on a PR), 0 failure, 0 in progress. The gate verdicts that matter here are all success: Test (shards 1 to 8) and the Test rollup, Test (dist pins), Type Check, Lint, Build & E2E, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Overwrite Report, Changeset Claim Re-read, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Line Citation Gate, Control Byte Scan, Inert vi.mock Specifier Check, Spec Main Shape Gate.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept-set changes: none. Public-surface changes: none.** No zod schema, no exported prop type and no exported signature moves. `StudioDesignSurfaceProps` (the package-root export) is untouched; `InterfacesPillar` and `ObjectActionsPanel` are not package-root exports (`src/index.ts` at the head exports `StudioDesignSurface`, `StudioDesignSurfaceProps`, the canvas-preview pair and `BuilderLanding` from the directory). `ActionItem` in `ObjectActionsPanel.tsx` is a module-private interface behind a `draft: Record` prop that is unchanged, so its `label` narrowing from `unknown` to `I18nLabel` reaches no caller. `packageApp` and `appLabel` are component-internal `useState` values. Right.

**Behaviour changes the diff implies, each judged:**

1. **`appLabel` held as `I18nLabel`, resolved at render** (sites 3 and 4 feed it; the rail heading now reads `tFormat('engine.studio.if.navHeading', locale, { app: navItemLabelText(appLabel, locale) })`). Right, and it is the direction's shape: `navItemLabelText` is `resolveI18nLabel(label, locale) ?? ''` over the spec's own resolver, the same helper the nav rows, `navSurface.resolveSurface`, `AppNavCanvas` and the nav-item inspector read through. Holding the map and resolving at render makes the heading follow a designer-language switch without reloading the app; the switch pin measures that (the app's `layered` call count is unchanged across en to zh) and ablation leg A3 (resolve once at load) fails only that pin. The `I18nLabel` and `navItemLabelText` imports were already present in the file at lines 25 and 119; the diff adds none.

2. **Site 3** (the published list row): `label: I18nLabel = published[0] ? (label ?? name ?? packageId) as I18nLabel : packageId`. Right: the fallback order is kept, `String()` is gone, and the draft-header branch below it (`label = String(d.name)`) is the draft's NAME, not a label read, as the PR table says.

3. **Site 4** (the loaded body) and the removed `typeof` guard. Old: `if (typeof body.label === 'string' || typeof body.name === 'string') setAppLabel(String(body.label ?? body.name ?? label))`, which a map label beside a string name passed straight into `String()`, the measured `[object Object] · Navigation`. New: `bodyLabel = (body.label ?? body.name) as I18nLabel | undefined; if (bodyLabel != null) setAppLabel(bodyLabel)`. Right: a map is taken as it is; a body with neither key keeps the list row's value exactly as the old guard did (it fell through); a plain string is unchanged (the control pin). The only input the two disagree on is a body whose `label` is neither string nor map, which `AppSchema` refuses. Ablation A1 (guard plus `String()` restored) fails the two body-loaded pins and the switch pin; A2 fails the two list-row pins. Each leg kills what it should and nothing else.

4. **Sites 1 and 2 (`packageApp.label`) hold the raw `I18nLabel` instead of resolving.** Judged right, and accepted as the deviation it is declared to be. The direction's two operative words are `resolveI18nLabel in the designer locale` and `never String() a label`. `packageApp` has no reader of `label` today (the head's only read is the topbar's presence gate `packageApp ? null : appDraftPending ? …`), so there is no locale to resolve in; resolving inside `resolvePackageApp` would either bake the load-time locale into state (the stale-caption shape the card puts out of scope) or put `locale` into the callback's dependency list and re-list the package's apps on every language switch. Holding the value as `I18nLabel` is the same choice sites 3 and 4 make, applied where the render does not exist yet; the type turns a future `String()`-free but resolver-less read (a JSX child, a `tFormat` variable) into a compile error that points at the helper. No `String()` over a label remains at either site. The Type Check run on the head is the only observer of these two sites and it holds. Nit, not a finding: site 1 spells the fallback `(a.label ?? a.name ?? '') as I18nLabel` while `name` beside it stays `String(a.name ?? '')` and site 2 spells it `d.label ?? String(d.name)`; the asymmetry is cosmetic (a spec-valid `name` is a string).

5. **`ObjectActionsPanel.labelText` = `label == null ? fallback : navItemLabelText(label, locale)`**, the local `default, en-US, en, zh-CN, first-string` order deleted, `locale` threaded from the component's existing `useMetadataLocale()` into both call sites (the list row and the editor-missing pane). Right: one helper, no second copy of the key choice, which is what the card and triage ask. On spec-valid input the change is confined to a map's entry choice: a plain string, `''` included, comes back as authored (the resolver returns a string unchanged); an absent label still falls to the action's name; a map now yields the resolver's choice for the designer locale (under zh the map `{ en, 'zh-CN' }` resolves through the region-sibling limb to the Chinese entry, which the zh pin and ablation C1 measure: C1 fails only the zh pin, showing `Send Email`). One nit, not a finding: an EMPTY map `{}` (which `I18nLabelSchema` admits) fell back to the action's name before and now renders `''`, because the helper's miss is `''`; that is the family's own semantic (a nav item with `{}` renders the same way) and the PR's "only a map's entry choice changes" is over-broad by that one degenerate input. Left as is: a `|| fallback` would also turn an authored `''` into the name.

6. **The directory sweep.** Re-done from the head's tree: 26 non-test sources under `views/studio-design/`, every `String(` hit read. The PR table is complete and each row is classified right: the four app-label reads are fixed; `labelText` is folded; the object labels in `loadPackageObjects` (line 984), `InterfacesPillar`'s package-objects effect (1836), `DataPillar`'s rail (3015) and `PackageOwdOverviewPanel` (138, 169), the field label in `ObjectFormDesigner.fieldLabelOf` (371), the hook label in `ObjectHooksPanel` (180, 278), the permission-set label in `AccessPillar`'s rail (4569) and `packageSurfaces.loadPackageSurfaces` (65, whose one caller at 4059 passes `'flow'`) are excluded on the spec's type; `label = String(d.name)` at 1880 is a name; line 1439 is prose. `navSurface.resolveSurface` already reads through `navItemLabelText`. The exclusions' reason holds against the spec source: `AppSchema.label` and `ActionSchema.label` are `I18nLabelSchema`; `ObjectSchema`, `FieldSchema`, `HookSchema`, `PermissionSetSchema` and `FlowSchema` type `label` as `z.string()`. The dev's zod probe was on the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0, which is the package's declared range (`^17.5.0` in `packages/app-shell/package.json` at the head); the spec source I read for the type check is 17.4.0 and agrees on every one of the seven. Nothing in the directory is left for a later card: the closure claim stands.

7. **The 11 pins and the 4 ablation legs.** `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesAppLabelMap-11181.test.tsx` (8): the fixtures parse against `AppSchema`; under en and under zh the body-loaded map heading (`Acme · Navigation` / `顶点 · 导航`), the list-row map heading with the body read held open (site 3 alone), and the plain-string control; then the en-to-zh switch. `ObjectActionsPanel.labelMap-11181.test.tsx` (3): the fixtures parse against `ActionSchema`; under en and zh the list row and the detail pane both show the designer-locale entry and not the other language's, the plain string as authored, and no `[object Object]` in the document. Both card pins are present under both locales, the control included. The harness is the objectui#11158 rail harness (real `InterfacesPillar`, mocked metadata client), so site 3 and site 4 are each measured through the real render. Ablation legs A1, A2, A3 and C1 each fail exactly the pins that read the mutated site; sites 1 and 2 are declared NOT MEASURED and that is the honest answer, since nothing reads `packageApp.label`.

8. **The nav-autosave region is untouched.** The diff's changed lines in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` are 958 to 963 (the `packageApp` state), 1029 and 1033 to 1034 (`resolvePackageApp`), 1617 to 1622 (the `appLabel` state), 1871 to 1872 and 1901 to 1904 (the two `setAppLabel` reads) and 2561 (the heading). `doNavSave` (2084 to 2117), the nav autosave's `blocked` (2115), the app-load effect's nav-buffer install (`setAppDraft(body); navBaselineRef.current = body; setNavHasDraft(!!appDraftBody);` at 1905 to 1907, which the hunk shows as context only), `navHasDraft` (1711, 2589), the Done / toggle close and the leave guard (833 to 856, 1648 to 1680, 4466 to 4517) are not in any hunk. objectui#11189's region is clean. Main has moved past the merge-base by one commit only (`81778b95`, PR objectui#11188, `ScreenView` / `FlowRunner` / `screen-spec`), which does not touch this file, and no PR for objectui#11189 is open, so this PR lands first and the sequencing note's "merge main and re-read the effect" duty falls on the later PR.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/11181-app-label-i18n-resolver.md` declares `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`. Right: a bug fix inside two internal components; no exported type, prop, schema or accepted input moves (① above). The changeset's prose describes what ships (the rail heading and the Actions view read a locale-map label in the designer locale; a plain string as before). The head's Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Overwrite Report and Changeset Claim Re-read runs are all success; the `-claims` flag on `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md` was read by the dev and its paragraph (marketplace chunk co-tenancy) stays true, since the diff adds no import.

`Clause-②: no` is on the PR body and on the claim, and it is the right reading: no accept set is widened and no public face is enlarged.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev `open_questions`: none. Dev deviations, each answered:

- **Sites 1 and 2 hold the raw `I18nLabel` instead of resolving (Zone 2 route suggestion).** Answered, accepted (① 4). The pin's intent, no `String()` over a label and resolution through the family's helper at the point of reading, is met; there is no reader to resolve at today and the type steers the first one.
